notes.title: v0.10 update
notes.content:
Note that, unfortunately, this build is not backward-compatible, and will tell you to start a new game.

Changes:

[list]
[*] Better trees
[*] Ghost plaques on monument
[*] better alphabet board cables (still not great)
[*] starting on pro buildings and pro character models
[*] wilbur and zojiro cutscenes on arrival night
[*] steam cloud save
[*] creepy cracks as zapato house puzzle
[*] various other fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Mayor May Knott v0.9 is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Here are the release notes![/b]
[h3]Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added opening credits animation with placeholder music and environments
[*] Overall visual improvements: fog, realtime AO
[*] Pro versions of several songs
[*] Added lapel flashlight to May
[*] Changed meeting G Clock to be spookier
[*] Changed Wilbur’s homeless behavior to be spookier
[*] Pastrami requests awning before she’ll come out during the day
[*] Added “statue” to repaired fountain
[*] Big change to Bea Miner model
[*] Various improvements to other characters
[*] New generic idle animation
[*] Added “furniture corners” to houses; currently G Clock is the only resident who has one
[*] Cleanup of a few building and house models
[*] Added Oak house
[*] Operating table model
[*] Implemented Scary / Friendly auras on unknown residents
[*] Removed rapport system
[*] Prevented May from fast forwarding on benches when it’s too late at night
[*] Made it easier to get corncobs
[*] Added more “Tater taunt” events
[*] Renamed “Cath” to “Kath”
[*] Added basement to mansion with workbench and mush room
[*] Changed mansion record player to tape player
[*] Improved mansion clock puzzle
[*] Added pipe-apple tree to mansion garden to make it easier to get pipes late game
[*] Lots of code improvements
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The event of Granny unboxing the Sweater Press sometimes happens again after the game is loaded. I know what's doing this, but the fix is tricky. So I left it in for now since it's not a big deal.
[/list]
As always, [b]please[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3341970/discussions/0/601903412169173235/]post any bugs you find to the community forums[/url]!

notes.title: build 0.8.4
notes.content:
new build is up.

[h1]v0.8.4:[/h1]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]added fortunes for the things that make May wake up earlier
[*]fixed name and lyrics of washing machine song
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]fixed bug where a request wouldn't complete if it was somehow already finished
[*]fixed ward not giving back big bug battery
[*]fixed cursed antiques accepting house early
[*]fixed option menu sfx machinegunning
[*]fixed repair UI moving too fast with mouse
[*]fixed mouse not working on desk letters UI
[/list]
I hope I uploaded the update correctly. Let me know if you have trouble running it.
